payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of approaches used in text analysis, including statistical text analysis and computational analysis, as well as the challenges faced in these methods.

claims.text: Statistical text analysis focuses on style, such as the distribution of function words, rather than content.
Computational analysis complements close reading to identify patterns in texts.
Insight-driven computational analysis helps reveal subtle patterns and explore new cultural and societal questions.
The research process in text analysis is labor-intensive and often requires interdisciplinary negotiation on methods.
